🧺 What Would You Bring to a Picnic with Your Hero?
Imagine you could go on a picnic with your favorite
Hero one day… 🌳✨
The first letter of your name determines the first
letter of the food you need to bring!

Let your imagination run wild and tell us what
delicious food you would bring to share with your
Hero! 😋

📅 Event Time
September 20 - September 27

🎁 Event Rewards
10 lucky players will be randomly selected from all
participants. Each winner will receive a $4.99 Gold
Block reward! 🎉

🎮 How to Participate
1. Imagine going on a picnic with your Hero.
2. Choose a food that starts with the same letter as
the first letter of your name.
3. Comment below and tell us your answer!
Please make sure to include:
In-Game Name
Server ID

Come see what delicious foods everyone would bring!
🧺🍓
Who knows? Your picnic menu might just be the best
one of all! ✨
